rules.name: The Black Rage
rules.description:
• When mustering your army, you must select 1 Blood Angels Infantry or Walker type unit that does not have the Veteran Keyword per 1,000pts to gain the Death Company special rule.
• A Blood Angels army must include at least 1 Death Company unit for every 1000pts.
•  Blood Angels Space Marine Captains may not purchase the Chapter Master upgrade.

rules.name: The Red Thirst
rules.description:
Blood Angels units gain the following special rules:
• Blood Angels Infantry, Bike, Cavalry and Walker type units gain the Rage special rule.
• All Blood Angels units in your army must make a Leadership test at the start of each of Combat Phase if they are engaged with an enemy unit:
• If the Leadership test is passed, the Blood Angels unit automatically pass all Panic tests they would be required to make that phase.
• If the Blood Angels unit fails the Leadership test, the Blood Angels unit gains +1 to its Strength (S) characteristic until the end of the Phase.
Designer note: You may opt to fail a Leadership Test when called instead of rolling per the Core Rules. This includes the Red Thirst test.

sharedRules.name: Angelic Visage
sharedRules.description: Enemy units within 3” of a unit with this special rule suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.

rules.name: Death Company
rules.description:
A unit with this special rule gains the following effects:
• The unit gains the Frenzy special rule and is always considered to be affected by the Frenzy special rule even if it has suffered no wounds or casualties.
• The unit with this special rule always counts as failing the Leadership test for the Red Thirst special rule (see Allegiance: Blood Angels).
• The unit automatically passes all Panic tests.
• The unit gains the Expendable special rule and does not count for Victory Points when Slain.
• The unit gains the Death Company Keyword.
• The unit cannot be joined by other units that do not have the Death Company Keyword.
Designer Note: The purchase of the Death Company special rule for a unit does not cost any points. It is free but mandatory.

rules.name: Blood Chalice
rules.description: At the start of your Movement Phase, the equipped model or any attached unit may Heal 1 wound. If the unit does not have any models that have suffered Wounds, you may return 1 Slain model to the unit with 1 Wound remaining.

rules.name: Artisan of war
rules.description: A model with this Warlord Trait can re-roll 1 failed Armour save (Armour only) per phase. All weapons the warlord is equipped with gain the Master-Crafted special rule.

rules.name: Selfless Valour
rules.description: Once per game, a model with this Warlord Trait can Charge in your opponent’s Charge Phase as if it were your Charge Phase. This is performed after all other Charges in that Phase have been resolved. If the model with this trait is attached to a unit, they detach from that unit if they successfully complete the charge. They may rejoin a new unit later.

rules.name: Avenging Angel
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, Friendly Blood Angels units that can draw visibility to this unit may use this units Leadership (LD) characteristic. This unit automatically succeeds when making a Charge roll so long as the Charge target is within 9” of this unit.

rules.name: Furioso Dreadnought
rules.description:
A unit with this upgrade exchanges its 2 Dreadnaught Close Combat Weapons & Storm Bolters for a Blood Fist, Storm Bolter and Heavy Frag Cannon.
● A Furioso Dreadnought may exchange its Smoke Launchers for a Magna Grapple for 10pts.
● A Furioso Dreadnought may exchange any of its Storm Bolters for one of the following:
○ Flamer for 5pts.
○ Meltagun for 15pts.
● A Furioso Dreadnought may exchange its Blood Fist or Heavy Frag Cannon for Blood Talons for 0pts each.

rules.name: Librarian Dreadnought
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains the Psyker (2) and Adamantium Will special rules. The unit gains a Psychic Hood. The Librarian Dreadnought exchanges its 1 of its Dreadnought Close Combat Weapons & Storm Bolters for a Force Halberd.

rules.name: Wings of Sanguinius
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit may immediately perform a Normal Move as if it were your Movement Phase.

rules.name: Shield of Sanguinius
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain a 5+ Invulnerable save until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Blood Boil
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 24” of the Psyker that does not have the Vehicle, Automata, Drone, Walker, Fortification or Aircraft type. The target unit suffers 1 Wound with no saves of any kind allowed and cannot be ignored by any means.

rules.name: Unleash Rage
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Rage special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase. If a unit affected by this Psychic power already has the Rage special rule, when they opt to declare the Rage in the Combat Phase, they gain +2 Attacks instead of +1.
